name: Zoho FSM
description: Zoho FSM is a comprehensive field service management solution designed to streamline operations, enhance customer satisfaction, and improve efficiency for businesses managing field services.

events.d: Creates a new user to Zoho FSM.
Create a company record with billing, service address, and tax details.
Create a service report for an appointment with technician notes and customer feedback
Create a contact in Zoho FSM.
Update a company's name or service address
Update the details of a specific contact.
Create an asset and link it to a product, contact, and company.
Create a service or part with tasks and tax info
Creates a new equipment record in Zoho FSM
